About The Company

DiDi's autonomous driving unit was established in 2016 with the mission of developing Level 4 autonomous driving (AD) technology to make transportation safer and more efficient. In August 2019, the unit became an independent company, DiDi Autonomous Driving, dedicated to advanced AD R&D, product application, and business expansion. We believe integrating AD technology into a shared-mobility fleet will generate immense social value. By leveraging DiDi's specialized technology, operational expertise, and integrated ecosystem, we are positioned to build and operate a highly efficient, user-oriented autonomous fleet.


About The Role

We are seeking a motivated PhD graduate with a strong research background in motion planning, robotics, or autonomous systems. In this role, you will apply your expertise in algorithm design and system integration to help develop next-generation planning capabilities for autonomous vehicles.

Responsibilities

  • Implement novel solutions for Behavioral Planning, enabling high-level decision-making for lane changes, merges, yields, and multi-agent interactions.
  • Design and optimize motion planning algorithms that integrate geometry-based path reasoning and context-aware speed reasoning into smooth, safe trajectories.
  • Develop and improve core geometry and velocity planning systems to ensure feasibility, compliance, and comfort across diverse driving scenarios.
  • Model complex driving environments and agent behaviors to create a robust world representation for planning under uncertainty.
  • Formulate cost functions and optimization frameworks that balance safety, comfort, and efficiency in trajectory selection.
  • Analyze, test, and debug system performance through simulation and real-world data, conducting root-cause investigations and proposing enhancements.
  • Collaborate with researchers and engineers across Perception, Prediction, and Control to ensure an integrated, reliable autonomy stack.

Qualifications

  • Recently completed or soon-to-complete PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Research or Internship experience in one or more of the following:
  • Motion planning algorithms (optimization, sampling, graph/search-based methods)
  • Behavioral planning and decision-making under uncertainty
  • Trajectory optimization and control
  • Multi-agent interaction modeling
  • Proven research ability demonstrated by publications in top-tier conferences (e.g., RSS, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, NeurIPS, CoRL).
  • Hands-on experience in C++ for implementing complex, real-time algorithms.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with a collaborative mindset.
  • For Internship Applicants: This role offers a clear pathway, with top-performing interns receiving the opportunity to convert to a full-time engineer upon successful completion of the program.

The hourly rate for the Intern position in the selected city is $46. Interns will also be eligible for Intern benefits. 

Applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. This posting is for an existing vacancy.

We are seeking a junior or skilled Software Engineer to join our team and develop the core decision-making and motion planning systems for our autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will be responsible for creating the algorithms that enable smooth, safe, and intelligent navigation in complex environments. You will tackle challenges across the full motion planning stack, from high-level behavioral reasoning to low-level trajectory optimization.

  • Model complex driving scenarios and agent interactions to create a robust world model for the behavioral planner.
  • Design different costs for trajectory ranking to trade off ETAs, comfort and safety of the vehicle behaviors.
  • Conduct in-depth analysis, testing, and debugging of the system's performance in various scenarios, leading root cause investigations.
  • Collaborate with Prediction, Perception, and Control teams to ensure a seamless flow from environmental understanding to physical vehicle motion.

Qualifications

  • B.S./M.S. in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field.
  • Experience in autonomous systems, robotics, or automotive software development.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ and Python for implementing complex, real-time algorithms.
  • Solid understanding of robotics fundamentals, including decision-making, motion planning, control theory, trajectory ranking, search and optimization algorithms etc.
  • Related experience in one or more of the following: behavioral planning, motion planning, behavior and world environment reasoning, trajectory ranking and cost design.

Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD or internship experience related to robotics planning system designs.
  • Knowledge of vehicle dynamics and longitudinal/lateral control systems.
  • Solid understanding of machine learning principles, reinforcement learning and related algorithms.

About Didi Autonomous Driving

Founded in 2016, DiDi's autonomous driving unit is dedicated to developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology to make transportation safer, more efficient, and accessible. In 2019, the unit became an independent company, Voyager, to accelerate technology development, commercialization, and large-scale deployment. By combining DiDi's unique data advantage, operational expertise, and mobility ecosystem, we aim to build a reliable, scalable autonomous fleet that integrates seamlessly with human-driven services. Driven by real-world customer needs and a strong commitment to safety and user experience, our mission is to deliver autonomous mobility solutions that create meaningful value for riders and communities.

 

About The Role

We are looking for an experienced and driven Machine Learning Engineer to join our autonomous vehicle team and develop the next-generation ML-powered planning system for Voyager's autonomous driving platform. You will leverage frontier ML techniques, including learned planners and end-to-end models, to build intelligent systems that understand complex driving environments, make data-driven decisions, and navigate safely and efficiently. Working alongside leading industry experts, you will leverage DiDi's unique data advantage, including petabytes of real-world driving data, to advance model performance, build robust evaluation frameworks that correlate with on-road safety, and accelerate the deployment and scaling of our driverless technology.

 

Responsibilities

  • Develop next-generation ML-powered systems that generate driving behavior decisions, scene understanding, and trajectories to support our L4 autonomous driving deployment roadmap.

  • Frame open-ended, real-world driving challenges as well-defined ML problems; research and apply cutting-edge techniques, including imitation learning, reinforcement learning, learned planners, and end-to-end models.

  • Design data-driven algorithms that improve the safety, generalization, and reliability of autonomous driving, including robust scene understanding and planning in complex or changing road environments.

  • Develop hybrid planning solutions that integrate ML-driven approaches with traditional rule-based and optimization-based planning, leveraging their complementary strengths to achieve superior safety, efficiency, and robustness in complex driving scenarios.

  • Develop and evaluate large-scale ML models using real-world driving data and simulation, translating learned representations into actionable planning guidance and integrating models into production systems under onboard compute, latency, and safety constraints.

  • Build infrastructure for rapid iteration, including challenging scenario mining, training and evaluation pipelines, closed-loop simulation, and metrics that correlate with real-world driving performance.

  • Collaborate closely with ML Infrastructure, Perception, Prediction, Planning, Mapping, and Systems Engineering teams to investigate failures, drive end-to-end improvements, and deploy solutions into real-world autonomous driving.

 

Qualifications

  • B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of industry experience for Senior, or 5+ years for Staff, in machine learning, autonomous driving, robotics, or related fields.

  • Proven track record of developing and deploying ML models in production, ideally for real-time, embedded, or autonomous driving systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Python and C++, with experience developing robust, efficient production software and hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow).

  • Deep understanding of modern deep learning techniques, including transformers, BEV and 3D representations, and trajectory prediction or generation models, with hands-on experience in model training, evaluation, and debugging.

  • Foundations in linear algebra, control theory, or motion planning, including path and trajectory generation, trajectory evaluation, cost function design, and lane and road geometry.

  • Experience applying machine learning to motion planning, robotics, or related decision-making problems, with the ability to integrate learning-based approaches with traditional planning methods.

  • Demonstrated ability to own ambiguous technical challenges end to end, balancing research innovation with production constraints, safety, reliability, and engineering trade-offs.

  • Demonstrated technical impact through research publications, open-source contributions, or significant achievements in industry.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong engineering experience applying ML-driven approaches to solve complex real-world problems, with a proven track record of translating research ideas into robust, production-quality systems and successfully deploying them.

  • Experience integrating learning-based approaches with traditional rule-based or optimization-based planning systems to improve safety, efficiency, and robustness.

  • Experience with closed-loop simulation, large-scale evaluation, and data-driven model iteration for autonomous driving.

  • Experience mentoring junior engineers, supervising research interns, or leading small technical teams.

  • Experience with road-structure representations, including lane graphs, topology reasoning, scene understanding, or uncertainty estimation in complex driving environments.

  • Experience with end-to-end autonomous driving models, learned planners, vision-language models, or foundation models applied to driving and robotics.

  • Experience deploying and optimizing ML models for real-time onboard inference, including TensorRT, CUDA, quantization, and compute or latency optimization.

  • Publications at leading conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, or IV, or equivalent demonstrated technical impact in industry.

About Didi Autonomous Driving

Founded in 2016, DiDi's autonomous driving unit is dedicated to developing Level 4 autonomous driving technology to make transportation safer, more efficient, and accessible. In 2019, the unit became an independent company, Voyager, to accelerate technology development, commercialization, and large-scale deployment. By combining DiDi's unique data advantage, operational expertise, and mobility ecosystem, we aim to build a reliable, scalable autonomous fleet that integrates seamlessly with human-driven services. Driven by real-world customer needs and a strong commitment to safety and user experience, our mission is to deliver autonomous mobility solutions that create meaningful value for riders and communities.

 

About the Role

We want our vehicles to understand the physical world as it is right now, instead of relying on a map drawn long ago. Roads change, and the world a car actually drives in is always more complex than any static record of it. We are seeking a Research Intern to help give our planner a more accurate and up-to-date picture of the world, so the vehicle handles complex real-world scenes more robustly. In this role, you will take on hard, open problems from real-world driving and solve them with frontier research methods. You will report directly to the team lead and work on the problem from definition to validated solution. Strong results will often be worth publishing, and we will support you in writing them up, but the goal is to solve problems that matter to the product.

 

Responsibilities

  •  Survey the latest research in scene understanding, prediction, and planning, and turn it into practical approaches that fit our system and constraints.

  •  Design and implement deep learning models that build a richer, real-time understanding of the driving environment from onboard sensors and other available sources.

  •  Train and evaluate models on large-scale data from our driving logs and on public benchmarks, and lead failure analysis to find out where and why models fall short.

  •  Define metrics and evaluation methods that connect perception quality to how the vehicle actually drives.

  •  Turn successful prototypes into solutions that work with our planning stack, with help from production engineers.

  •  Collaborate with Perception, Prediction, Planning, and Mapping teams so results move from experiment to product.

  

Qualifications

  •  Currently enrolled in an M.S. or Ph.D. program in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, for the full duration of the internship.
